original_test_intent: Boot the exact approved NVIDIA FieldDiag environment through BMC virtual media, execute level-2 baseboard diagnostics with `--no_bmc`, require every in-scope subtest plus aggregate result to pass, and restore the normal OS healthy.
original_method: Pin image/archive/entrypoint and platform support; verify BMC/SUT identity, virtual-media target, boot order/console and OOB recovery; drain jobs and capture inventory/log baseline; mount/boot with explicit approval; hash/extract package, expand subtest roster and run exact command under watchdog; preserve every result/telemetry; unmount, restore boot, return OS and compare GPU/PCIe/firmware/management/log health.
manual_activity: Operator supplies/validates the image, controls BMC virtual media/boot/console and outage/recovery, approves level-2 scope and owns subtest disposition/verdict.
required_inputs: Signed exact FieldDiag image/archive/hash and platform support manifest
Verified BMC/SUT identity, virtual media and console/OOB access
Approved boot order, maintenance/job drain and normal-OS restore procedure
Protected evidence capacity, watchdog and hardware recovery policy
safety_requirements: Never mount or boot unverified/incompatible image
Verify BMC target and preserve current boot configuration
Drain jobs and require operator/OOB presence before power/boot action
Abort on mount/boot timeout, unknown subtest, unsafe telemetry or hardware anomaly
Unmount media, restore boot and prove normal OS/management/GPU health; no auto-retry
agent_execution_scope: After operator approval run exact level-2 entrypoint in FieldDiag environment
Collect aggregate and every subtest result/health evidence
Coordinate cleanup/restore and report without DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve image, scope, outage and recovery
Control virtual media/boot and disposition failed/skipped subtests

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Journal virtual-media mount/boot, immutable image identity, expanded subtest roster/results and the unmount/normal-boot recovery transaction with pre/post inventory/health.

modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: `--no_bmc` intentionally excludes BMC tests; excluded scope must be explicit and cannot be reported as full controller coverage.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master coherently defines virtual-media FieldDiag level2/no_bmc; DeepSeek undercovers it.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Image, BMC access and recovery are provisionable prerequisites; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Restores alternate-boot coverage, exact scope and per-subtest evidence and treats normal-OS restoration as part of the test transaction.
independent_technical_reasoning: Diagnostics run in a dedicated image can have different drivers and hardware access than the installed OS, so an SSH-host command is not equivalent. A top-level PASS may coexist with skipped components, requiring the expanded subtest roster. Virtual media and boot-order state are themselves failure modes; successful restoration and identical GPU/PCIe inventory are necessary evidence that the diagnostic did not leave the platform unusable.
